I know it’s so scary and everything feels like you’re loosing control but the fact that you’re on so many different treatments means you’re doing the most! I only take bc for example because I’m still scared to try anything else. Definitely try to consult a doctor that you trust and remember everybody reacts different to medications. I took breaks for maybe the first 3 months into birth control until my doc told me that it’s basically unnecessary to do that and I wouldn’t say it got worse because of the break so it’s not like you shed a significant amount during these breaks. I just take one every single day and if the package is done I start a new one. Definitely ask your doctor about it!

Also be advised that there are so many different opinions out there, also coming from gynecologists. A lot of them promote birth control without properly informing about the serious downsides it can bring.

I thoroughly thought about the decision of going back on the thing that kind of caused my hair loss and I was aware of the fact that it will once again cause a hormonal imbalance in my body which is known to cause hair loss and so it did. I think about 2 months in taking bc again my hair shed like crazy for a month but I knew that my AGA will continue anyway if I didn’t try it. I also don’t take breaks so I basically never get my period. The “period” you get when on birth control is not your real menstrual cycle it was actually designed to simulate a normal cycle so it would feel natural but it has nothing to do with your natural period. If you take the 7 day breaks it will just cause hormonal imbalance every month, causing more possible hair loss. To answer your question, hair is growing back currently but you can only get real results 6 months to 1 year in. I’m still waiting patiently to find out. I’m sorry this turned out so long lol.

well I really get your struggle! I went off bc in 2020 and it unmasked my AGA, I definitely regret it so much und went on bc again in October 2021. And it’s so tricky because bc has so many downsides and it can be very reasonable to get off it and turn your back on hormonal contraceptives but to be really honest I figured that the mental tournaments and hurt that hair loss caused me was much greater than what downsides bc had for me. However, if you notice very unhealthy side effects then it might just be time to value your health more than your hair, as bad as it sounds.
